\[
f(x, y) = \frac{1 - b}{1 + b}\, b^{\lvert x \rvert + \lvert y \rvert},
\qquad
B = [\, f * Y - Y > 0 \,]
\]

The formula shows the default parameter values.

where

- \(f\): The ISEF kernel
- \(b\): The smoothing factor, from 0 to 1
- \(Y\): The luma of the image
- \(B\): The binary Laplacian

f is the discrete ISEF. It sums to 1 and is separable, so it is applied along the rows and then the columns. Along each line, a forward recursion and a backward recursion, each with the factor b, add up to the kernel. The smoothed image minus the original approximates a Laplacian, limited to a band of frequencies. B is 1 where it is positive. Edges lie on the border of the regions where B is 1. We keep the border pixels where the gradient of the smoothed image passes the hysteresis thresholds.
